text: The author contests the myth that DAOs are generally run by scammers: many DAOs and users have indeed fallen victim to rug pulls, but most of those rug pulls trace to the absence of decentralized governance in fundraiser DAOs rather than to DAOs as such.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, DAO Fallacies (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4067783
abstract: While it is true that many DAOs and DAO users have fallen victim to the infamous rug-pulls, most of these rug pulls are associated with the lack of decentralized governance in fundraiser DAOs.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to fundraiser DAOs lacking decentralized governance
